routes.pageOrObject: Page 22 / Debitoren / Customers via Role Center link or Tell-Me while an informational Power BI dialog can block the surface
routes.purpose: Open Debitoren/Customers and inspect the New/Neu boundary by repeating direct Page 22 URL, visible Role Center Debitoren link, or bounded Tell-Me while the dialog state is unresolved.
routes.result: Direct Page 22 stayed on Role Center, the visible Debitoren link did not prove the list, and Tell-Me stayed blocked by a foreground Power BI setup information dialog. No customer data was created or changed.
routes.whyRejectedOrParked: Repeating the same navigation route would again treat Role Center text or an unresolved foreground dialog as customer-list evidence.
routes.riskIfRepeated: Could falsely classify Role Center/New menu text as Debitoren-list proof and then advance to customer write gates without the target page being open.
